definitions.explanation: The act of drawing milk from a cow, goat, or other animal, by hand or by machine.

examples.japanese: {牧場|ぼくじょう}で{乳搾|ちちしぼ}りを{体験|たいけん}した。
examples.english: I tried milking at a ranch.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{牛|うし}の{乳搾|ちちしぼ}りをする。
examples.english: I milk the cows every morning.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}は{手|て}で{乳搾|ちちしぼ}りをしていたが、{今|いま}は{機械|きかい}を{使|つか}う{農家|のうか}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: In the past milking was done by hand, but now many farms use machines.

notes:
Composed of {乳|ちち} (milk) + {搾|しぼ}り (squeezing, from {搾|しぼ}る, to wring or press out).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乳搾|ちちしぼ}りを{体験|たいけん}する: to try milking as a hands-on experience
- {手|て}{搾|しぼ}りの{乳搾|ちちしぼ}り: hand-milking
- {牛|うし}の{乳搾|ちちしぼ}り: milking a cow
